BLOB_ADDR

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x10
Size:
0x4
Source:
blob_detect_grid_regs.rdl

Description

Blob table read index. Selects which blob entry is presented on BLOB_COUNT_RD, BLOB_SX, BLOB_SY, BLOB_XMIN, BLOB_XMAX, BLOB_YMIN, and BLOB_YMAX. When CTRL.BLOB_ADDR_AUTOINC = 1, auto-increments (wrapping at MAX_BLOBS-1) on each blob data read. Bits [31:8] are reserved / read 0.
